title: helictotrichon planiculme subsp. angustius
intro: Helictotrichon planiculme subsp. angustius, commonly known as a type of grass, is a plant species that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Helictotrichon planiculme subsp. angustius include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, making it a promising candidate for the treatment of various health conditions.
